chapter: Hopkins, the South and Stuff Smith
title: Refused service at a Michigan border diner
summary: Coming out of Canada, a waitress in the North told his band 'We don't serve your kind', which shocked him more than the South had.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Yeah, that's what I mean. So now we came back to Ohio, I mean Illinois, Michigan. We played Canada now. We come out of Canada, going into Detroit, we stopped at the border, and we get some -- we saw a joint -- hot dogs, and crap, so we got out and ordered for the -- I did, several of us, and ordered some hot dogs and hamburgers,

or whatever it was, go to them and say We don't serve your kind here! I say what? And she was very indignant, very mad. I say -- well I called -- I don't know what I didn't call her, and went under my breath, and my -- then I started to think. I said we've been all down Alabama, Georgia, and all that stuff, and been treated swell. While there, where I expected to run into this, and didn't -- and here I am back in the north, you know, mid-west, where I expect to be treated like a human being, and I run into this.
It really knocked me on my feet, you know? So you ask yourself why, how does it get turned around that way? You know what I mean?
Did that happen very often to you in the north, as opposed to the south?
Yes, it -- yes it did. Yes it did.
No, not more so, but I mean --

More than I expected, and when I didn't expect it, because I said well I'm out of that part of the country where this has been going on for hundreds of years, and now I'm here where it's supposed to be human, where it's supposed to be nice, shoot! Man, I -- well, what are you going to do with a thing like that when you -- you say well I wouldn't care -- what do you think? This is the way
it is here, and get out, and which we run into a hell of a lot of that. You know.
Yeah. I mean like us, we don't serve your kind, we don't serve you in here. And you're not going to Anything like that, be served.
